h1: The 7 Best Paper Shredders for Credit Cards of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best Credit Card Shredders 2026: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: 7 paper shredders that also destroy credit cards, compared on cut type, sheet capacity, run time and bin size.
summary: The Bonsaii 12-Sheet Cross Cut is our top pick, with a 15 minute run time and jam-proof reverse. The Amazon Basics Micro Cut has the finest particles here, the Bonsaii 15-Sheet shreds the most paper, and the Amazon Basics 8-Sheet is the cheapest.
intro: Most shredders say they handle cards, but the real question is how finely they cut and how long they run. A fast overheat on a pile of junk mail makes any shredder annoying.
We reviewed seven paper shredders that list credit card shredding, and ranked them on cut type, sheet capacity, continuous run time and bin size. Every pick sits between $25 and $100.

products.name: Bonsaii 12-Sheet Cross Cut Heavy Duty Paper Shredder for Home Office
products.verdict: A 15 minute run and jam-proof reverse.
products.description:
The Bonsaii 12-sheet lists P-4 cross-cut security, a 15 minute continuous run of about 900 sheets, a 5.5 gallon bin and jam-proof reverse, in the $50-100 tier. It shreds CDs, credit cards and staples.

It leads because the long run time beats every other model here, including the 15-sheet Bonsaii at 10 minutes. It trades 3 sheets of capacity for endurance.

It suits home offices with regular shredding. The caveat is cross-cut particles are larger than micro-cut.

products.name: Bonsaii 15-Sheet Cross Cut Paper Shredder for Home Office Heavy Duty
products.description:
This Bonsaii lists 15 sheets, P-4 cross-cut security with alloy blades that take cards, discs and staples, a 10 minute run and a 5.5 gallon bin with safety interlock, in the $50-100 tier.

It ranks second because it shreds more sheets per pass than the leader but runs five minutes less.

It suits bigger batches. The caveat is the shorter run time.

products.name: Amazon Basics High Security Micro Cut Paper Shredder, 8 Sheet Capacity
products.verdict: The finest particle size in this ranking.
products.description:
The Amazon Basics micro cut lists P-4 security, 4.5 by 12 mm particles, a 5 minute run, a 4 gallon pull-out bin on casters, and destroys CDs, DVDs and credit cards, in the $50-100 tier.

Third place goes to this one since it has the finest cut here but only 8 sheets of capacity.

It suits privacy-first buyers. The caveat is lower capacity.

products.name: Bonsaii Micro Cut Paper Shredder, 10-Sheet, Home Office, 5.5-Gallon bin
products.verdict: Micro cut with 10 sheets and a big bin.
products.description:
This Bonsaii lists P-4 micro-cut at 5 by 12 mm, 10 sheets, a 5 minute run, and a 5.5 gallon bin, shredding cards, clips and staples, in the $50-100 tier.

It ranks fourth because it offers more capacity than the Amazon Basics micro cut but with a slightly larger particle.

It suits buyers wanting micro cut and a big bin. The caveat is the 5 minute run.

products.name: Amazon Basics 12-Sheet Cross-Cut Paper and Credit Card Shredder
products.verdict: 9 minute run with a 5 gallon bin.
products.description:
The Amazon Basics 12-sheet lists P-3 cross-cut, 5 by 30 mm particles, a 9 minute run and a 5 gallon bin, in the $50-100 tier. It shreds cards one at a time, not metal ones.

It ranks fifth because P-3 particles are larger than the P-4 models above.

It suits general home use. The caveat is the larger particle size.

products.name: Bonsaii 10-Sheet Heavy Duty Cross Cut Paper Shredder for Home Office
products.verdict: A 10 sheet P-4 cross cut for junk mail.
products.description:
This Bonsaii lists 10 sheets, P-4 cross-cut at 5 by 18 mm, a 4 minute run and a 5.5 gallon bin, shredding cards one at a time, junk mail and staples, in the $50-100 tier.

It ranks sixth because the other Bonsaii models run longer or hold more.

It suits light shredding. The caveat is the 4 minute run.

products.name: Amazon Basics 8-Sheet High Security Cross Cut Paper and Credit Card Shredder
products.verdict: The lowest price tier with P-4 security.
products.description:
This Amazon Basics shredder lists 8 sheets, P-4 cross-cut at 5 by 18 mm, a 3 minute run and a 3.7 gallon bin, in the $25-50 tier. It shreds cards one at a time, not metal ones.

It ranks last because it has the smallest bin and shortest run, but it costs the least.

It suits occasional use. The caveat is the 3 minute run.

whatMatters.detail: P-3 and P-4 are security ratings, and a higher number means smaller particles. Micro cut shreds into tiny pieces, while cross cut makes strips. Look for the P rating and particle size in the bullets.
Most of these shred credit cards one at a time, and none handles metal cards. Check the listing to confirm cards are supported.
Run time is how long it can shred before it must cool down. A 3 minute run is short for a big stack. Look for the minutes figure.
Capacity is how many sheets it takes per pass. Feeding more than the rating jams it. Check the sheet figure.
A small bin forces frequent emptying. Larger bins hold more shreds. Check the gallon figure.
